description: Find HS or SITC commodity codes by keyword, partial description, or code prefix in the selected classification. Returns descriptions, native aggregation levels, parents, leaf status, and recommendedQueryCode for subsequent trade queries. HS uses levels 2 (chapter), 4 (heading), and 6 (subheading); SITC uses levels 1–5. Select the edition matching the trade records when interpreting historical codes.

aggr_level.description: Native aggregation level: HS uses 2 (chapter), 4 (heading), 6 (subheading); SITC uses 1–5. Omit to return all matching levels.

classification.description: Goods reference catalog: HS uses the default HS.json discovery catalog, whose total identifies H6; it is not an authoritative historical-edition reference. Select H0–H6 for an explicit HS edition, or SS/S1–S4 for SITC.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; above 200 returns all matching codes.

query.description: Keyword, partial description, or commodity code prefix. Examples: "motor vehicles", "8471", "coffee", "84" (HS chapter 84 = machinery).

name: comtrade_search_commodities

classification.description: Reference catalog used for the search.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_aggregation_level`: The requested level does not belong to the selected classification family. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matches.description: Commodity codes matching the query in the selected classification.

items.description: A commodity entry from the selected catalog.

aggrLevel.description: Native aggregation level in the selected HS or SITC catalog.

id.description: Commodity code in the selected classification, preserving leading zeros.

isLeaf.description: Whether this code has no sub-codes (leaf node in the HS hierarchy).

parent.description: Parent commodity code in the selected classification.

recommendedQueryCode.description: Code to pass as cmd_code with the same classification in trade data queries.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no matches are found or results are truncated. Absent when results are non-empty and not truncated.

shown.description: Number of codes returned in this response.

truncated.description: True when matches were capped at the limit (totalMatches exceeds shown).

title: Search Commodity Codes
